properties.notes: A planning application is currently under consideration for the development of 75 dwellings on the site. It is expected to be approved subject to a s106 agreement being agreed. The developer has indicated that development will commence by the end of the year subject to the planning application being approved. It is predicted that all of these dwellings will be completed in the five year period..
